properties.notes: Redevelopment of the site: Three storey building with lower ground floor for seven self-contained flats (five x three-bed, two x two-bed) (demolition of Locally Listed Hillside Mansion remains); refurbishment and continued use of Locally Listed Gardener's Cottage as a single dwellinghouse; refurbishment and use of Grade II Listed Coach House and stables as a single dwellinghouse; associated hard and soft landscaping, bin and cycle storage, car parking.
